newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nobel Design wins S$11 mln contracts.
newsitem.headline: Nobel Design wins S$11 mln contracts.

text.p: Singapore's Nobel Design Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday the company had been awarded contracts worth S$11 million to be carried out in 1997 and 1998.
The contracts are for the design, supply and installation of kitchen cabinets and units to various projects, the company said in a statement.
A contract for the government's executive condominium project at Simei was valued at about $5.3 million.
The balance of $5.7 million was accounted for by other contracts of lower value awarded to the company, it said.
Nobel said these contracts were not expected to have any material effect on the earnings per share and net tangible assets per share of the company for the current financial year.
It also announced the establishment of a joint venture company in Brunei with Ahmad Morshidi Abdul Rahman called Nobel Gordon Gifts Sdn Bhd (NGG).
The parties intend that NGG will increase its issued and paid-up capital to B$500,000, of which 65 percent of the issued shares will be held by Nobel and 35 percent by Morshidi.
